statements: All vertex and edge-intersection ordinates partition the plane into slabs.
Crossing order is fixed within each open slab; line-intersection endpoints are affine functions of height.
Unions, differences and distinct-camera thresholds therefore have affine cross-section lengths within a slab.
Rational midpoint integration gives exact area for the represented polygon coordinates.
A second arrangement incorporating returned boundaries integrates full geometric symmetric-difference area.
Convex half-plane intersections plus inclusion-exclusion independently agree on55cases and220scalar equalities.
overlap_merge: O=O_A union O_B union(U_A intersection U_B)
precondition: Child leaves partition DISTINCT camera IDs; fragments with one ID are unioned first.
guard_clipping: For subjectZ inside guardB, threshold sets onZ are unchanged when each camera is intersected withB.
